subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person who helps willingly without being paid for it
solution: The correct answer is '**Volunteer**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Volunteer**'. • It means 'a person who offers or agrees to do something without being forced or paid to do it'. [स्‍वयंसेवक (बिना किसी शुल्क अथवा दबाव के कुछ करने को तैयार)] • *Example: Are there any **volunteers** to do the washing up?* **Correct Answer:__** *Volunteer.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Beggar**: a person who lives by asking people for money, food, etc. on the streets. (भिखारी, भिक्षुक, भिखमंगा) • **Worker**: a person who works, especially one who does a particular kind of work. [कार्यकर्ता, कर्मी (विशेष प्रकार का काम करने वाला व्‍यक्ति)] • **Leader**: a person who is a manager or in charge of something. (किसी काम का प्रबंधकर्ता या प्रभारी व्‍यक्ति, नेतृत्‍व-कर्ता) 30:T4f5, The correct answer is **'To make efforts'.**
